title: twas-xcal: ancestry-aware null calibration for transcriptome-wide association studies
description:
twas-xcal provides XCAL-t, an ancestry-aware null calibration for summary-statistic TWAS tests (S-PrediXcan type) under polygenic backgrounds. The polygenic inflation slope of a TWAS statistic is a weight-specific LD score of the GWAS population (the general slope of Liang, Nyasimi & Im 2026), so variance-control corrections computed in European LD are miscalibrated in other ancestries. XCAL-t scales weights by GWAS allele-frequency SDs, uses an ancestry-matched LD panel with a moment-corrected estimator of the polygenic variance term, LD-score-regression estimates of the intercept and slope (leave-one-chromosome-out), and a delete-group jackknife Satterthwaite t reference that also propagates the LDSC standard errors.

The release includes a benchmark that counts false positives against an exactly known simulated null (3,540 gene models per ancestry, 1.06e8 tests per setting, infinitesimal and sparse architectures, exact genomic-control counts), an individual-level GWAS check, a leave-one-chromosome-out benchmark with estimated intercept and slope (including confounded GWAS), a real-genotype benchmark (1000 Genomes phase 3 x 12,478 MESA expression models; model-based) and an application to Biobank Japan height (12,195 models), with per-step provenance records. Version 0.3.0 responds to a re-audit of v0.2.1; v0.2.x and v0.1.0 are superseded (see CHANGELOG and docs/AUDIT_RESPONSE.md).
